details.tolerance_note: CPU float32 replay of CUDA float16 cache; not an exact-bit test. Parent raw256 equality is the exact integrity test.

scope_caveats: This audit verifies cache provenance, frozen-input identity, row/geometry consistency, media hashes, and checkpoint causal replay. It cannot prove GPU device ownership during the already-completed run except from the frozen started/receipt records.
The CPU float32 causal replay is approximate because the production values were computed on CUDA in float16; exact parent track_feats equality is checked separately.
